local_scale: SF19 UCI_Elo-setting equivalent at 30 ms/move, one thread, 64 MiB hash
scope: Provisional local benchmark index anchored to an advertised development-opponent dial. Not FIDE, online-account or CCRL Elo; not full-strength Stockfish superiority.

generation.split: Seeded-shuffled parent first 16 screening openings; next 128 confirmation openings, frozen before Aster queries. Exclude 20k/60k development datasets, fresh endgame diagnostic and five prior opening suites.

screen.selection: Choose smallest absolute difference of screening score from 0.5; tie chooses lower setting. Only for selection, unresolved games contribute 0.5 points.

confirmation.opponent_setting: Selected by the above frozen screen rule

model: R = selected_setting + 400 * log10(score / (1 - score)); fixed local reference model, not a validated mapping to public Elo.

uncertainty.primary: 95% opening-family bootstrap; family is first four legal UCI opening plies; preserve both colors per opening.
uncertainty.unresolved: Retain unresolved outcomes. Bootstrap lower/upper endpoints separately using 0/1 for unresolved games. Suppress numeric point estimate if any remain unresolved.

numeric_estimate_gates: All 416 requested games recorded and independently audited with zero forfeits
Confirmation complete with 128 color-swapped pairs and no unresolved games
Finite transformed primary interval with width at most 200 local rating units
Point and primary interval stay within the supported 1320..3190 reference range
fallback: Report unestablished numeric rating plus measured score/interval or supported reference-setting bound; never clip infinite estimates into a finite rating.
randomness: Stockfish weak selection has no exposed seed; retain all PGNs and observed searches. Same options do not imply bitwise repeatable games.
decision: No playing-code changes or engine promotion in response to these results. Preserve rating record with exact binary, source, opponent options, hardware, openings and controls.
